mercimek.name: Soupo ea Lentile
mercimek.description: Soupo ea lentile e entsoeng ka tlung e lokiselitsoeng ka mokhoa oa khale, e phethetsoe ka soso ea botoro.

tas-kebabi.name: Stew ea Nama ea Khomo ea Turkey
tas-kebabi.description: Nama ea khomo, meroho ea nako, le soso ea rona ea reschorente e phehiloeng butle-butle.

kuzu-tandir.name: Namunu e Butle e Halikiloeng
kuzu-tandir.description: Namunu ea tandoori ea reschorente ea rona, e phehiloeng butle-butle ka mocheso o tlase.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Raese Pilaf
pirinc-pilavi.description: Pilaf ea raese ea Baldo e nang le botoro le e futhumetseng.

firin-sutlac.name: Pudding ea Raese e Halikiloeng
firin-sutlac.description: Pudding ea raese e halikiloeng ka mokhoa oa setso, e lokiselitsoeng ka lebese la buffalo la letsatsi le letsatsi.

kuru-fasulye.name: Stew ea Pebe e Tšoeu le Nama
kuru-fasulye.description: Lipeo tsa İspir, nama ea beef e khethiloeng, le pate ea tomato ea reschorente e tloaelehileng.

izgara-kofte.name: Li-Meatball tse Halikiloeng
izgara-kofte.description: Li-meatball tsa nama ea nama ea nama ea Bakere tse nang le pepere e halikiloeng le tomato.

ayran.name: Ayran e Tlatsetsweng
ayran.description: Buttermilk ea setso e tlatsetsweng ka sefate se ngata, e entsoe ka yogurt ea letsatsi le letsatsi.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Ezogelin Soup
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Sopo ea setso ea reschorente moo lentils tse khubelu, bulgur, le raese li kopana le mint.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Tarhana Soup
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana ea lehae, e leng sehlahiswa sa Anatolian se phehiloeng butle-butle le tomato le mint e omeletseng.

yayla-corbasi.name: Jusi ea Yoghurt le Raese
yayla-corbasi.description: Jusi e pholileng ebile e bosoeu e neng e lokiselitsoe ka yoghurt, raese, le manyolo a omisitsoeng.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Jusi ea Matšoele
iskembe-corbasi.description: Jusi ea matšoele a nama ea khomo e loketseng e sebeletswang hammoho le linoko tsa eona le veine ea konofolo.

dugun-corbasi.name: Jusi ea Lenyalo
dugun-corbasi.description: Jusi ea lenyalo ea setso e entsoeng ka nama ea nko e kotsi e halikiloeng le ho latsoa ka marinade ea lemone.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Jusi ea Khoho
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Jusi e phekotsoeng e lokiselitsoe ka dinoodle tse tenya tse phehiloeng ka broth ea masapo le nama ea khoho e koroletsoeng.

domates-corbasi.name: Jusi ea Toma
domates-corbasi.description: Flavour e ngata e bililoeng ka tamati e eletsang, botoro, le basil, e phethetsoeng ka chisi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Motsoako oa Meroho
sebze-corbasi.description: Motsoako o bobebe oa reschorente o lokiselitsoeng ka meroho ea nako, oli ea oliive, le litlama tse ncha.

beyran-corbasi.name: Motsoako oa Lamb Beyran o Futhumetseng
beyran-corbasi.description: Motsoako oa sebakeng o lokiselitsoeng ka mocheso o phahameng ka nama ea rabele, raese, konofolo, le pepere e chesang.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Motsoako oa Hlooho le Mahloho
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Motsoako o ruileng oa moro o entsoeng ka mahe a nama ea kolobe le nama ea hlooho e phehiloeng lihora tse ngata.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Motsoako oa Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Soup ea letsatsi le letsatsi e lokiselitsoeng ka moro oa hokokho ka tamati, vermicelli, le parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Li-Skewer tsa Khoho
tavuk-sis.description: Likhopolo tsa khoho tse tletseng lijo tse ikhethang, li sebeletsoa le pepere le tamati e halikiloeng.

kasap-sucuk.name: Butcher's Sucuk e Halikiloeng
kasap-sucuk.description: Soseji ea nama ea linku e cheselitsoeng ka charcoal, e nang le meroho e halikiloeng le onion ka sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill e Kopaneng
karisik-izgara.description: Poleiti e ngata le e fapaneng ea grill e nang le meatballs, li-skewer tsa khoho, li-lamb chop, le soseji.

nohut-yemegi.name: Stoof ea lebele le Nama ea Nku
nohut-yemegi.description: Sejana sa lapeng sa li-chickpea le nama ea khomo e khabisitsoeng ka tatellano e apehang ka mokhoa o liehang ka pitseng ea koporo.

patlican-musakka.name: Moussaka ea Lebese la Eggplant
patlican-musakka.description: Lebese la eggplant le besitsoeng, nama ea khomo e qhibilihisitsoeng, le moussaka e bilikiloeng ka ovens ka moro oa tamati, ka mokhoa oa reschorente.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Di-Bean Tse Tala ka Oli ea Litholo
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Sejana sa setso se phehiloeng ka oli ea litholo tse tala, tamati, le onion, se sebeletsa se phodile.

tavuk-sote.name: Khoho e Qhibilihisitsoeng ka Oli
tavuk-sote.description: Likotoana tsa khoho li qhibilihisitsoe ka mocheso o phahameng le diaparo tse mebala e fapaneng, li-mushroom, le tamati.

izmir-kofte.name: Li-Meatballs tsa Stilse sa İzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Sejana sa setso sa mantlha sa li-meatball tsa nama ea khomo, litapole, le pepere tse halikiloeng ka soseng ea tamati.

etli-bezelye.name: Ipe le Nama ea Khomo
etli-bezelye.description: Sejana sa letsatsi le letsatsi se phehiloeng ka poto se nang le nama ea khomo e sehiloe ka likotoana, ipe, karote, le litapole.

patlican-oturtma.name: Beringela e Halikiloeng ka Nama e Sehiloe
patlican-oturtma.description: Leleme le lokiselitsoe ka ontong le beringela, nama e nang le linoko e sehiloe, le sosese ea tamati le konofolo.

salgam-suyu.name: Joala ba Turnip bo Fermented
salgam-suyu.description: Joala ba setso ba turnip bo nang le linoko bo ferment joalo ka karote e putsoa le tlhapi ea bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Metsi a Mineral
maden-suyu.description: Metsi a mineral a tlhaho a hloekileng a sebeletsang a batang.

su.name: Metsi a Noka a Tlhaho
su.description: Metsi a tlhaho a noka a tšeloa a batang ka botlolo ea khalase.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: Joala bo tloaelehileng bo nang le khase bo tšeloa bo batang haholo.

gazoz.name: Soda ea Lemone ea Turkey
gazoz.description: Soda e nang le monko oa setso, e pholileng, 'me e tšeloa e le e sa tsoakiloeng le ho itlosa mofuthu.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kofi ea Turkey
turk-kahvesi.description: Kofi ea setso ea Turkey e nang le foam, e phehiloeng ka mocheso o phahameng ka cezve ea koporo.

demleme-cay.name: Tee e halikiloeng ea Turkey
demleme-cay.description: Tee e ncha ea Rize e chesang ka khalase e selelele e tsubang.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Limonade ea lehae
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Limonade e ncha e lokiselitsoeng letsatsi le letsatsi ka lero le lecha la lemone, mints, le tsoekere e nyenyane.

hosaf.name: Meroho ea Letlalo ea Letsatsi le Letsatsi
hosaf.description: Compote ea lapeng e besitsoeng letsatsi le leng le le leng ka raisini, apricots, kapa plums ho latela nako.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Nama e potoloha skewer holim'a pide, e fanoang le sauce ea tamati, borouto bo chesang, le yogurt.

kazandibi.name: Pudding ea Laitse e Entsoeng ka Caramel
kazandibi.description: Sejo sa setso sa lebese se entsoeng ka caramel hantle, se na le sebopeho se bonolo.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Pudding ea Lebese ea Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Lijo tsa motswako o bobebe le o khelohileng tsa lebese tse lokiselitsoeng ka risepe ea setso, tse hlahlojoang ka kanele.

keskul.name: Puding ea Lebese la Almonde
keskul.description: Lijo tsa motso oa lebese tsa Ottoman tse felisitsoeng ka tatso ea almonde le koko.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva ea Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva ea semolina, e besitsoeng ka botoro le litlhapi tsa pine, e sebeletsoang e chesang ebile e na le peo.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Lijo tsa Lehlaka la Lebese le Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Lehlaka, le phehiloe butle ka morung oa lona, le sebeletsoang le tahini le walnuts.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Lijo tsa Quince
ayva-tatlisi.description: Quince e phehiloe ka cloves le kanele e sebeletsoang e na le kirimi e tiileng le walnuts.

revani.name: Keikeng ea Semolina e Nang le Syrupu
revani.description: Sejo sa setso sa reschorente moo keikeng e bonolo ea semolina e kopanang le syrupu e nang le nko ea lemoene.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Phudung ea Bureka ea Bohobe e Nang le Krema e Thutsisang
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Phudung ea bohobe e phomotsitsoeng ka syrupu e khabisitsoeng e beheletsoa hammoho le krema e thutsisang ea phoofolo ea buffalo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava ea Walnut
cevizli-baklava.description: Malebela a lohiloeng ka bophara bo botle, baklava e crispy e entsoeng ka walnuts tse ngata le botoro bo tloaelehileng.
